facts.fact: Otuba Paul of PIH Liberia says AI-powered chest X-ray interpretation (qXR v3.2) was deployed to support TB screening at James Jenkins Dossen Hospital in Maryland County from March 2023 to January 2025, with the National Leprosy and Tuberculosis Control Program and the county health team, and helped identify Xpert-negative and asymptomatic patients.

systems.owner: James Jenkins Dossen Hospital, Maryland County; NLTCP; Partners In Health Liberia
